_comment: Single source of truth for every planned site image. The page renders a block ONLY when its asset exists on disk; tools/verify-site.mjs enforces that. status: PENDING = not yet generated, LIVE = file present and QC-passed.
_qc: Every LIVE asset must carry a qc score (0-100) recorded from a visual review, and a designation of CONCEPT or PRODUCTION.

assets.alt: Professional cinema camera on a lit commercial food set, shallow depth of field across a plated dish
assets.brief: Bright commercial production still. Cinema camera body and lens in the near foreground, angled at a plated dish on a warm set. Softbox and practical lighting visible but OUT of frame edges. Warm ivory and food-red palette, high clarity, editorial. Horizontal 16:9. No text, no logos, no faces.

assets.alt: Macro detail of a cinema lens aperture ring and front element
assets.brief: Macro of a cinema prime lens: aperture ring, focus marks, front element catching a warm highlight. Bright, clean, premium. Shallow depth of field. No text, no logos.

assets.alt: Concept: a plated dish shot flat under overhead kitchen light, before art direction
assets.brief: Deliberately ORDINARY reference frame. A good dish photographed badly: flat overhead fluorescent light, cluttered pass in background, dull color, phone-camera look, slight overexposure. Must read as an untreated real-world snapshot, NOT as a styled image.

assets.alt: Concept: the same dish directed, lit and composed as campaign-ready commercial food photography
assets.brief: Same subject, fully directed. Bright directional daylight from camera left, controlled falloff, rich natural color, considered negative space, editorial food-magazine treatment. Physically correct steam and sheen. No text, no logos.

assets.alt: Concept: an unbranded jar shot flat on a countertop, before art direction
assets.brief: Deliberately ORDINARY. An unbranded jar with a BLANK cream label on a cluttered kitchen counter, flat overhead light, harsh small-source shadow, dull color. Phone-camera look. Label must stay blank - never invent a brand.

assets.alt: Concept: the same jar directed as a campaign-ready packaged-food hero
assets.brief: Same jar, BLANK label preserved, fully directed. Static camera, controlled specular on glass, warm key with a cool rim, fresh ingredient supporting cast, wet slate or warm stone ground. Premium packaged-goods hero. Label stays blank.

assets.alt: Concept: a cold drink shot flat on a bar top, before art direction
assets.brief: Deliberately ORDINARY. A tall cold drink on a bar top under flat warm downlight, condensation unremarkable, background clutter, muddy color, phone-camera look.

assets.alt: Concept: the same drink directed as a campaign-ready beverage hero with backlight and motion
assets.brief: Same drink, fully directed. Strong backlight through the glass, ice reading crystalline, a physically correct splash frozen at 1/2000, citrus and mint supporting cast, saturated but natural color. Premium beverage advertising.

assets.alt: Concept: an unbranded consumer product shot flat on a desk, before art direction
assets.brief: Deliberately ORDINARY. An unbranded consumer product (blank packaging) on a desk, flat ceiling light, keystone distortion, dull color, phone-camera look. Packaging stays blank.

assets.alt: Concept: an unbranded consumer product directed as a campaign-ready hero with copy space
assets.brief: Blank packaging preserved. Cream-to-blush gradient ground, crisp edge light, controlled reflection, generous negative space at right reserved for campaign copy. Horizontal 3:2. Packaging stays blank.

assets.alt: Professional cinema camera mounted on a tripod on a bright production set
assets.brief: Cinema camera body on a tripod, low three-quarter angle, bright ivory set, equipment softly out of focus behind. No text, no logos, no people.

assets.alt: Commercial food photograph of a colorful seafood dish in bright directional daylight
assets.brief: Bright high-key plated seafood. Saturated fresh color, shallow depth of field, editorial food-magazine treatment. No text, no logos.

assets.alt: Commercial photograph of an unbranded bottle with a blank label on a warm gradient set
assets.brief: Premium packaged-goods hero. Tall bottle with a COMPLETELY BLANK label, warm coral and cream gradient, crisp edge light, herb and citrus supporting cast. Label stays blank.

assets.alt: Commercial beverage photograph of an unbranded citrus soda bottle with backlight and splash
assets.brief: Chilled unbranded bottle, COMPLETELY BLANK label, condensation, citrus and ice, physically correct splash, brilliant backlight. Label stays blank.

assets.alt: Hospitality photograph of a bright restaurant dining room in warm afternoon light
assets.brief: Upscale dining room, set tables, linen and glassware, daylight through tall windows, warm wood and greenery. No people, no signage, no brand names.

assets.alt: A chef finishing a plate on the pass under warm service light
assets.brief: Chef's hands plating on a restaurant pass, dining room softly out of focus behind. Human, warm, editorial. No faces in focus, no text, no logos.

assets.alt: Lighting setup shaping a food set with softbox, flag and bounce card
assets.brief: Honest production process shot: softbox key, black flag, white bounce card, C-stands, styled plate on a sweep. No text, no logos, no people.

assets.alt: Cinema camera and lit product set during a commercial production
assets.brief: Behind-the-scenes production still: cinema camera rig on a tripod with a director's monitor, softbox and LED panel, unbranded product set on a plinth. Bright studio. No people, no text, no logos.
